name: Lucy Mack Smith
dateNote: Joseph Smith’s vision of 21 January 1836 places her in the celestial kingdom while she was still living.
importance: Lucy Mack Smith is not named in the D&C, but section 137 says Joseph saw “my father and my mother” in the celestial kingdom. She was baptized on 6 April 1830, the day the Church was organized. In May 1831 she led a company of Fayette branch members to Kirtland. She later wrote a history of the Smith family, published in 1853.
connections: She married Joseph Smith Sr. in 1796; their children included Alvin, Hyrum, Joseph, and Samuel H. Smith. Section 137 places her beside her husband and her son Alvin.

sources.title: Lucy Mack Smith, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: Dates checked on the JSP page; the death date was partly cut off but read 14 May 1856. Named only indirectly (“my mother”) in 137:5, so no linkNames. The list of children is from general knowledge, not the JSP page.
